title: Original Character – Full-Body Illustration
description: Designed as an original character for use in a variety of future illustration and animation projects. The character was designed with versatility in mind, organizing the overall silhouette, outfit, hairstyle, and other core design elements to allow for a wide range of poses and situations.

title: Lycoris Recoil – Fan Animation
description: An animation created using CLIP STUDIO PAINT, combining blinking, hair movement, and arm motion to achieve natural character animation.

title: The Irregular at Magic High School – Fan Art
description: A calm moment capturing the relationship between the characters and the seasonal atmosphere. I focused on their distance, eye direction, and overall composition to convey a sense of story.

title: Torn Tights / ENVTuber Zentreya – Fan Art
description: A piece built around the contrast between movement and expression. I focused on guiding the viewer’s gaze through the composition while balancing the playful tone with the character’s personality.

title: Contrast / ENVTuber Zentreya – Fan Art
description: I aimed to capture her playful charm through expressive facial features. By balancing strength and cuteness, I portrayed the multifaceted nature of her character.

title: Summer Vibes with Snuffy / ENVTuber Snuffy – Fan Art
description: Fan art of ENVTuber Snuffy. I aimed to highlight her soft charm within a bright summer atmosphere. The background colors and outfit tones were balanced to create a natural sense of season and openness.

title: The Irregular at Magic High School – Tatsuya Shiba Fan Art
description: I emphasized texture with a painterly approach, focusing on the character’s calm demeanor and underlying tension. By keeping color contrast subtle, the expression and composition convey his strength.

title: The Irregular at Magic High School – Miyuki Shiba Fan Art
description: I aimed to portray her strength and elegance, adding motion to the composition. A simple background enhances her presence, while the white outline adds depth and contrast.
